eyebrow: The cost of comparing to everything

steps.label: BRUTE FORCE

steps.label: AN INDEX HELPS

code:
1,000,000 vectors in the collection
nlist = 1,000  -> ~1,000 vectors per cluster
Query arrives -> compare to 1,000 centroids
nprobe = 10    -> probe the 10 closest clusters
Scan ~10,000 vectors, not 1,000,000
100x fewer comparisons than brute force
caption: Illustrative numbers — partition first, then only search the nearest clusters.

code:
Layer 3:        ~4 nodes  (long jumps)
Layer 2:       ~60 nodes
Layer 1:      ~900 nodes
Layer 0: 1,000,000 nodes  (every vector)
Search starts at Layer 3, descends toward Layer 0
Each layer down narrows the answer further
